MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A basket of mangoes has a mass of 8 kg. The empty basket has a mass of 1 1/2 kg. What is the mass of the mangoes? (1 mark)
   A. 9 1/2 kg
   B. 6 kg
   C. 6 1/2 kg
   D. 7 kg

2. The table shows the favourite sports of 10 pupils: football 5, netball 3, athletics 1, swimming 1. How many more are there of football than of netball? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 2
   C. 3
   D. 8

3. 29 eggs are packed in trays that each hold 4 eggs. How many trays are needed to pack all the eggs? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 7
   C. 9
   D. 6

4. Which fraction of an hour is 15 minutes? (1 mark)
   A. 1/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

5. In the pattern blue square, orange square, blue square, orange square, and so on, what colour is the 6th square? (1 mark)
   A. Red
   B. Green
   C. Orange
   D. Blue

6. What is 4 1/2 L + 2 1/2 L? (1 mark)
   A. 7 1/2 L
   B. 7 1/4 L
   C. 6 3/4 L
   D. 7 L

7. Which of these shows 460 in words? (1 mark)
   A. four hundred and six
   B. four hundred and sixty
   C. five hundred and sixty
   D. forty-six

8. Change 35 days to weeks and days. (1 mark)
   A. 0 weeks 5 days
   B. 6 weeks
   C. 5 weeks
   D. 5 weeks 1 days

9. Which of these is a multiple of 4? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 27
   D. 30

10. School ends at a quarter past three in the afternoon. How do we write this time? (1 mark)
   A. 3:45 p.m.
   B. 3:15 p.m.
   C. 3:15 a.m.
   D. 15:3 p.m.

11. Write 0.6 as a fraction. (1 mark)
   A. 60/10
   B. 6/10
   C. 1/6
   D. 6/100

12. What is the rule of the pattern 750, 1,000, 1,250, 1,500? (1 mark)
   A. add 250
   B. add 500
   C. add 750
   D. subtract 250

13. Which is the smallest number: 0.4, 0.44, 0.04, 0.404? (1 mark)
   A. 0.44
   B. 0.04
   C. 0.4
   D. 0.404

14. What is the next number in the pattern 5,000, 4,750, 4,500, 4,250, ...? (1 mark)
   A. 4,000
   B. 4,250
   C. 3,750
   D. 4,750

15. Simplify 6p − p. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5p
   C. 6p
   D. 7p

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Two runners finish a race in 12.4 seconds and 12.35 seconds. Who is faster? Explain. (3 marks)

17. One layer of a cuboid has 15 blocks and the cuboid has 4 layers. Find the volume. Then find the volume if 2 more layers are added. (4 marks)

18. Write 4, 6 and 9 as Roman numerals. (3 marks)

19. Draw a rectangle of 3 rows and 5 columns of squares. Write its area. (3 marks)

20. Njeri had Ksh 5,000. She bought a school bag for Ksh 1,850. How much change did she get? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 6 1/2 kg
   8 − 1 1/2 = 6 1/2 kg.

2. B — 2
   5 − 3 = 2.

3. A — 8
   29 ÷ 4 = 7 remainder 1. The 1 left-over eggs need one more tray, so 8 trays are needed.

4. C — 1/4
   15 × 4 = 60, so 15 minutes is one quarter of an hour.

5. C — Orange
   The colours alternate blue, orange. Squares 2, 4 and 6 are orange.

6. D — 7 L
   Work with the whole litres first and then the parts. 4 1/2 L + 2 1/2 L = 7 L.

7. B — four hundred and sixty
   460 = four hundred and sixty. Say the hundreds, then "and", then the tens and ones.

8. C — 5 weeks
   35 ÷ 7 = 5 remainder 0, so 35 days = 5 weeks.

9. B — 28
   28 = 4 × 7, so 28 is a multiple of 4.

10. B — 3:15 p.m.
   Times from midnight to noon use a.m. and times from noon to midnight use p.m. The correct answer is 3:15 p.m..

11. B — 6/10
   The last digit of 0.6 is in the tenths place, so the denominator is 10. 0.6 = 6/10.

12. A — add 250
   Each number is 250 more than the one before it, so the rule is add 250.

13. B — 0.04
   Give every number the same number of decimal places and compare from the left. The smallest number is 0.04.

14. A — 4,000
   The rule is subtract 250. 4,250 − 250 = 4,000.

15. B — 5p
   Only like terms can be joined. 6p − p = 5p.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: The runner with 12.35 seconds is faster. 12.4 = 12.40, and 12.35 is less than 12.40, so it took less time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for writing 12.4 as 12.40, 1 mark for comparing, 1 mark for the correct runner.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: 60 blocks; then 90 blocks
   Working / marking points: 15 × 4 = 60 (2 marks); 6 layers: 15 × 6 = 90 (2 marks).

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: IV, VI, IX
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each. IV is 5 − 1, VI is 5 + 1, IX is 10 − 1.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: A drawing with 3 rows of 5 squares; area = 15 square units.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 3 rows, 1 mark for 5 columns, 1 mark for area 15.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ksh 3,150
   Working / marking points: 5,000 − 1,850 = 3,150. 1 mark for the subtraction and 1 mark for the answer with Ksh.
